description: This file defines the PolicyIdInvalidException class, a specialized exception indicating an invalid policy ID in the Ditto framework. It includes constructors for creating instances with various contextual information, static factory methods for JSON-based instantiation, and an internal builder class for fluent construction.

classes.name: PolicyIdInvalidException
classes.description: A final, immutable exception class indicating an invalid policy ID, extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException. Provides static factory methods and a nested builder for flexible instantiation.

classes.name: PolicyIdInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class enabling fluent creation of PolicyIdInvalidException instances, customizable with message, description, cause, headers, and hyperlink.

methods.name: PolicyIdInvalidException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with headers, message, description, cause, and hyperlink.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Static method returning a new builder instance for constructing a PolicyIdInvalidException with a given policy ID.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Static factory method creating an instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method creating an instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns array of supported JSON schema versions (V_2).

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
